## ReferenceScope interface

What a reference value type needs to know about the app its references belong to: the app and its resource table.

**Signature:**

```typescript
interface ReferenceScope
```

## Remarks

`app` is the app contract's `app`<!-- -->. Decoding stamps it on every reference, container, and entry it produces, and encoding rejects a reference whose `app` differs, at any level, before any call is made. `resources` is the [ReferenceRegistry](./contracts.referenceregistry.md)<!-- -->, which also admits a resource as a container only when it has `get`<!-- -->. An app contract is assignable to this type, so generated code passes the contract itself rather than building a parallel description of the app.
